pause_generation: pause generation on a running vLLM server via the HTTP pause endpoint
resume_generation: resume generation on a paused vLLM server via the HTTP resume endpoint
test_data_parallel_pause_resume: test coordinated pause and resume across multiple vLLM data parallel ranks
run_pause_resume_script: run the data parallel pause resume test script against a local vLLM server
verify_pause_gap: verify the token generation gap matches the expected pause duration after resuming
